### Summary

This is a **95-amino-acid MinE cell-division topological specificity factor**. The sequence exactly matches reviewed UniProt protein **A9W265** from *Methylorubrum extorquens* PA1 (100% identity and coverage).

MinE’s annotated role is to counteract the division-inhibiting MinC/MinD system at internal sites while permitting inhibition near the cell poles. This helps ensure the division septum forms at the cell midpoint. Related MinE annotations also support roles in **cell division** and **regulation of septum assembly**.

**Sequence-derived characteristics:** approximately **10.6 kDa**, theoretical **pI 9.77** (basic), and GRAVY **−0.087** (near-neutral, slightly hydrophilic). These are computational estimates for the unmodified sequence.

The functional summary is based on an exact match to a reviewed UniProt annotation; no new experimental assay was performed here.
